title: The Happy Ending Problem
exact_target: How many points in general position guarantee a convex polygon with a prescribed number of vertices? Is the minimum always one more than the standard power-of-two lower bound?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1214 (GEO-023). CC BY 4.0.
Andrew Suk, \emph{On the Erd\H{o}s--Szekeres convex polygon problem}, arXiv:1604.08657v2 (2016), Section 1 and footnote 1.
